summary: Live chatbot bridge on Mac mini cannot answer: configured LLM (deepseek-v4-flash via opencode.ai/zen/go/v1) returns HTTP 403 RegionError (China-hosted model requires opt-in at workspace URL). Local Bonsai fallback not yet viable: reasoning model consumes default token budget (bridge llm-client sends no max_tokens -> empty message.content), and max_tokens=4096 generation exceeded gateway upstream timeout (502).
root_cause: 1) opencode gateway denies deepseek-v4-flash in this region until account opt-in. 2) Bonsai 27B is a verbose reasoning model; mlx_lm.server default max-tokens comes from the chat template, so bridge calls without max_tokens return empty content; large-budget calls exceed bonsai-gateway upstream timeout.
